tests.title: fix's analyse phase lists a function's callers in one find_references call, and the envelope counts that call under usage.phases[0].tool_calls.find_references.
given: cmd/fix's real App with --repo-map-tokens 0 on a committed repository whose main.go declares func Count and whose util.go has func Total calling Count
a scripted faux model installed with toolio.SetRunnerConfigHook: analyse calls find_references {name: Count} then submit_analysis, implement calls write_file then submit_implementation
the real tools.All, Runner and git
tests.when: fix --repo-map-tokens 0 --land none --verify true --no-review <report naming Count> runs to the end
then: the first request's system prompt names `find_references` in step 2 and its 'Your tools are exactly:' list includes find_references
the second request carries the find_references result, which lists the site attributed to its enclosing declaration Total and a confidence label (resolved, lexical or text)
the run exits 0 and the envelope's usage.phases[0].name is analyse with tool_calls.find_references equal to 1
usage.phases[1] (implement) records no find_references call
